statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring via CPT 93229 was ordered
The service is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
